title: Festung Nauders am Reschenpass
highlights: Only completely preserved Old Austrian military road barrier
Imposing mountain fortress hewn into living rock around 1840 to secure the Reschen Pass
Fortress museum displaying historical artillery, casemates, and armaments
Fascinating guided tours through the labyrinthine underground tunnel network
kurzbeschreibung: Festung Nauders is a completely preserved 19th-century Habsburg valley barrier built to secure the Reschenpass.
beschreibung:
Imposing Valley Fortification along the Reschenstraße

Festung Nauders is located at a narrow pass along the Reschenstraße north of Nauders. Constructed between 1834 and 1840 under Emperor Franz I and Emperor Ferdinand I, the fortress served as a strategic road barrier guarding North Tirol against invading troops advancing from the south.

Authentic Military History Cut into Living Rock

As the only completely preserved fortification of this era in all of Tirol, the structure impresses with massive ashlar masonry, embrasures, and cavernous chambers cut deep into the mountainside. Inside, the road barrier houses an engaging military history exhibition featuring historical cannons, period uniforms, and intricate scale models of imperial Austrian military architecture.
